notes: Real-paper gold case from STUDY-d7633d624b5a, DOI 10.1111/1755-0998.13677, PMCID PMC9796769. Curated from stored Europe PMC full-text evidence for the sponge eDNA persistence study.
source_text: The raw sequencing data were first trimmed to remove low-quality ends using obicut. After trimming, paired-end reads were merged by illuminapairedend. The alignments were then demultiplexed using ngsfilter with default parameters. Subsequently, quality filters were performed by obigrep to retain sequences between 130 and 190 bp without ambiguity. The remaining sequences were clustered by swarm version 2.1.3 with -d 3, followed by chimera removal using the de novo chimera search function in vsearch 2.4.3. Taxonomic assignment was performed via ecotag. The reference database used in ecotag was constructed by in silico PCR for Tele02 primers against the EMBL database, release r143, using ecoPCR.
